text:
The second photo shows no food, only an "Oops!" card, so I can't see what was left. I'll assume everything was eaten and estimate the full meal from the first photo.

Estimated items:
- Toast: 4 slices of thick-cut bread at about 80 kcal and 35 g each, so 320 kcal and 140 g.
- Poached or fried egg: 70 kcal, 45 g.
- English muffin with ham: about 150 kcal for the muffin plus 30 kcal for the ham, so 180 kcal and 120 g.
- Blueberry muffin: 380 kcal, 110 g.
- Latte or cappuccino: 100 kcal, 250 g.
- Apple juice, about 200 ml: 90 kcal, 200 g.
- Peaches in a bowl: 50 kcal, 100 g.
- Jam and butter portions: 4 jam pots at about 25 kcal and 20 g each, so 100 kcal and 80 g. About 4 butter portions at about 35 kcal and 8 g each, so 140 kcal and 32 g. Together that is 240 kcal and 112 g.

Totals: 320 + 70 + 180 + 380 + 100 + 90 + 50 + 240 = 1430 kcal. Mass is 140 + 45 + 120 + 110 + 250 + 200 + 100 + 112 = 1077 g.

The spreads may not all have been used, so I'm reducing the estimate to roughly 1300 kcal and 1000 g.
